pages.title: Tip
pages.text: Right click a player with a coin (or hit them with a thrown one) and they get 30 seconds of:$(li)$(thing)Goad$(): +4 attack damage, +40% attack speed$(li)$(thing)Boss$(): +6 max health, +4 armor

pages.title: Numbers
pages.text: Goad is +2 damage / +20% attack speed per level, Boss is +6 health / +4 armor per level. Tipping uses the configured levels (Goad II, Boss I by default).$(br2)Like and the megaphone give level I Goad (+2 / +20%) for a shorter time.
